Courses

Courses offered by TRAIL faculty at the Department of Computer Engineering, METU.

CENG403

Introduction to Deep Learning

  • Undergraduate
  • METU credit 3(3-0)
  • 5.0 ECTS
  • Coordinator: Prof. Dr. Sinan Kalkan

An introduction to deep learning for senior undergraduates: fundamental concepts in machine learning, the history of artificial neuron models, perceptron learning, gradient descent and its alternatives, multi-layer perceptrons, convolutional neural networks and recurrent neural networks.

METU catalog entry

CENG501

Deep Learning

  • Graduate
  • METU credit 3(3-0)
  • 8.0 ECTS
  • Coordinator: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Emre Akbaş

A graduate course on the foundations and practice of deep learning: optimisation and regularisation of deep networks, convolutional and recurrent architectures, attention and transformers, and generative models, with hands-on implementation of state-of-the-art methods.

METU catalog entry

CENG502

Advanced Deep Learning

  • Graduate
  • METU credit 3(3-0)
  • 8.0 ECTS
  • Coordinator: Prof. Dr. Sinan Kalkan

A research-oriented graduate course on recent advances in deep learning. Students study current literature on topics such as self-supervised learning, generative models, large language and vision-language models and their trustworthiness, and reproduce results from recent papers.

METU catalog entry

CENG7880

Trustworthy and Responsible AI

  • Graduate
  • METU credit 3(3-0)
  • 8.0 ECTS

Ethical concepts and principles of trust and responsibility in AI; computational methods for dependability and robustness in AI; computational methods for explainability in AI; computational methods for bias and fairness in AI.
